column1: # note: The tax computation worksheets for taxable income of $100,000 or more, printed below the tax table: $4,562 plus 0.0475 over $100,000 for single or married filing separate; $4,373 plus 0.0475 over $100,000 for married filing joint, head of household or qualified widow(er).
# note: Each worksheet is repeated for every status it covers. Its single bracket starts at $100,000 itself, since the worksheet is for $100,000 or more.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
